# BoardFlight

> BoardFlight turns a US flight number into one arrive-by time: when to get to the airport, built for that airport, terminal and hour. It is not boarding time. Free, no account. Covers 33 US airports.

BoardFlight looks up the flight, then adds curb-to-check-in time, bag drop if you have a bag, a modeled security wait for that airport and hour (read at the 88th percentile, so it plans for a slower-than-usual day), and the walk to the gate. It uses no live queue data. Airline check-in and boarding deadlines always come first.

Security-wait curves are checked against TSA's published hourly checkpoint throughput. The check covers the shape of each airport's day (when it peaks), not exact minutes. Airport-page charts pass that check at 16 of 33 airports: AUS, BNA, BOS, DCA, EWR, HNL, JFK, LAS, LAX, LGA, PHX, SAN, SEA, SFO, SNA and TPA. Pages for the other airports give arrive-by guidance but no hour-by-hour wait figures.

## Main pages
- [Check a flight](https://www.boardflight.com/): enter a flight number, get one arrive-by time
- [Airports](https://www.boardflight.com/airports): all 33 airport profiles
- [How it works](https://www.boardflight.com/how-it-works): what goes into the time, and why not just "two hours early"
- [Methodology](https://www.boardflight.com/methodology): the model, the TSA check and what it does and doesn't prove
- [Boarding time vs. arrive-by time](https://www.boardflight.com/guides/boarding-time): when boarding starts and ends at major US airlines, from their own pages
- [Data study](https://www.boardflight.com/data): when security is quietest and busiest at 8 airports

## Data study (8 airports, modeled medians for Thu, Aug 13, 2026)
Shown only for airports where both BoardFlight curves passed the TSA check. Each airport is compared only with itself.
- Austin Bergstrom International (AUS): the shortest waits of the day come around 7 PM; worst about 23 min at 4 PM
- Boston Logan International (BOS): the shortest waits of the day come around 10 PM; worst about 15 min at 6:45 PM
- John F. Kennedy International (JFK): quietest about 13 min near 5 AM; worst about 30 min at 6 AM
- John Wayne Orange County International (SNA): the shortest waits of the day come around 9 PM; worst about 15 min at 6 AM
- Nashville International (BNA): the shortest waits of the day come around 9:45 PM; worst about 10 min at 12 PM
- Ronald Reagan Washington National (DCA): the shortest waits of the day come around 10 PM; worst about 20 min at 7 AM
- San Diego International (SAN): quietest about 5 min near 10 PM; worst about 39 min at 9 AM
- Tampa International (TPA): the shortest waits of the day come around 10 PM; worst about 29 min at 6 AM
- 6 AM is the worst weekday hour at 3 of 8 of these airports.

## Open data
- Dataset: https://github.com/daniel1001a/boardflight-airport-wait-data (12 airports, CC BY 4.0). Cite as "BoardFlight airport security wait data".
